sections.title: Identity and observed environment
sections.intro: Preserve prediction, actual observation, evidence origin and limitation. Write PENDING explicitly where applicable to a draft.

fields.label: Surname
fields.help: Enter your own surname. This assessment identification stays in your private submission.

fields.label: Given name
fields.help: Enter your own given name. Do not enter another student's data.

fields.label: Group
fields.help: Enter your actual group, not the synthetic example group.

fields.label: C04/S04 versions or package IDs
fields.help: Read the supplied version and PACKAGE_ID.txt. Record C04 and S04 separately; do not invent an identifier.

fields.label: Operating system
fields.help: Record the operating system actually used. UNKNOWN is better than an assumed version.

fields.label: Terminal used
fields.help: Name the terminal actually used, or explain why no command could run.

fields.label: Observed Node version
fields.help: Copy node --version output, or UNKNOWN with the reason.

fields.label: Observed npm version
fields.help: Copy npm --version output, or UNKNOWN. No install command is needed.

fields.label: Browser and observed version
fields.help: Record the browser and version actually used, or PENDING with the intended next check.

fields.label: Actual launch route
fields.help: Distinguish direct file opening for the form from the printed loopback HTTP address for project applications.

sections.title: P01 prediction and result
sections.intro: Preserve prediction, actual observation, evidence origin and limitation. Write PENDING explicitly where applicable to a draft.

fields.label: Original prediction
fields.help: Write before running: profile, open/total counts, notice count and initial/final state. Keep the first prediction after a discrepancy.

fields.label: Exact fixture and request paths
fields.help: Name supplied browser data versus canonical objective data. List all three /data/*.json paths.

fields.label: Allowed edit path
fields.help: Only projects/p01/public/dashboard.js is the P01 edit target. Record this exact path.

fields.label: Actual command or action
fields.help: Copy the actual command or precise browser action; include flags and which project was checked.

fields.label: Named checks and actual statuses
fields.help: Record baseline/objective/regression/full results with test names. Separate canonical raw exceptions from derived assertion checks and runtime guards.

fields.label: Initiation, completion and result order
fields.help: Use the injected deferred witness. Explain request initiation versus release/completion versus aggregate ordering; label MODEL_OR_INJECTED.

fields.label: Loading/final model and visible output
fields.help: Distinguish the controller model from visible DOM output. Record the observed states and return, not only a green label.

fields.label: Comparison with the preserved prediction
fields.help: State the discrepancy or agreement without replacing the original prediction. Give the smallest discriminating check.

sections.title: Failure boundary
sections.intro: Preserve prediction, actual observation, evidence origin and limitation. Write PENDING explicitly where applicable to a draft.

fields.label: Predicted failure and UI transition
fields.help: Predict the model and visible state before selecting missing-tasks, malformed-tasks or the injected transport witness.

fields.label: Reproducible failure setup
fields.help: Record the exact controlled scenario and command; do not edit fixtures or contact public endpoints.

fields.label: Observed result
fields.help: Paste a short real result or state PENDING with a next action. Do not use expected output as an observation.

fields.label: Transport, HTTP or parsing classification
fields.help: Say TRANSPORT, HTTP_STATUS or JSON_PARSE and justify the boundary. An HTTP 404 is not a transport rejection.

fields.label: Evidence excerpt and identifier
fields.help: Give an evidence identifier and a short command/output excerpt; distinguish MODEL_OR_INJECTED, LOCAL_HTTP and REAL_BROWSER.

fields.label: What this witness does not establish
fields.help: Explain what the one witness does not establish, including cancellation, arbitrary input or browser behaviour.

sections.title: Browser evidence
sections.intro: Preserve prediction, actual observation, evidence origin and limitation. Write PENDING explicitly where applicable to a draft.

fields.label: Browser observation state
fields.help: OBSERVED means that you actually used a browser. An alternative requires separate explicit teacher authorisation, not this selection.

fields.label: Actual local URL or explicitly unknown
fields.help: Copy the actual printed URL and scenario. Never copy a synthetic port as an observed address.

fields.label: Network/DOM/console evidence or authorised alternative reference
fields.help: Record Network/DOM/console actions and results. For an approved alternative include AUTHORISATION: teacher, date, scope and reference.

fields.label: Limit of the browser evidence
fields.help: Describe missing evidence honestly. For PENDING, specify the next browser action.

sections.title: Bounded Gemini verification
sections.intro: Preserve prediction, actual observation, evidence origin and limitation. Write PENDING explicitly where applicable to a draft.

fields.label: Actual interaction state
fields.help: Select ACTUAL_INTERACTION only after a real bounded interaction. The offline synthetic exercise does not satisfy it.

fields.label: Sanitised context and date
fields.help: Use a sanitised context and actual interaction date. An approved alternative needs AUTHORISATION: teacher, date, scope and reference.

fields.label: Relevant prompt
fields.help: Include only the relevant bounded review prompt, not a complete conversation.

fields.label: One selected claim
fields.help: Copy or precisely paraphrase one selected claim. Do not attribute the synthetic practice text to Gemini.

fields.label: Independent verification
fields.help: Give a reproducible independent check and the observed result; identify the evidence class.

fields.label: Verdict
fields.help: Choose a verdict justified by evidence. UNKNOWN and a defensible rejection are legitimate outcomes.

fields.label: Correction or justified no correction
fields.help: Give the correction or explain why none is justified; agreement is not the assessment target.

fields.label: Remaining limitation
fields.help: State the remaining limit. Never paste credentials, cookies, tokens or private records.

sections.title: Required P02 portfolio
sections.intro: Complete after the seminar; source workload 45–60 minutes. P02 is required, not optional.

fields.label: Prediction before implementation
fields.help: Record the expected rows, event target and callback effect before working on Task List.

fields.label: One-file edit contract
fields.help: Only projects/p02/public/task-view.js may be edited for P02.

fields.label: Commands and action sequence
fields.help: Record check commands and browser actions: valid/blank submit, toggle, nested delete, unbind and rebind.

fields.label: Actual baseline/objective/regression/full results
fields.help: Distinguish derived teaching checks from canonical baseline/objective/regression/full results. Report TypeError or other failures truthfully.

fields.label: DOM projection and plain-text witness
fields.help: Observe state-to-DOM projection and a literal sample title. It must remain text rather than a parsed element.

fields.label: Direct/nested target, currentTarget and action trace
fields.help: Compare a direct checkbox or button click with a nested span click; record callback counters and the actual event fields.

fields.label: Bind/unbind/rebind observation
fields.help: Use the separate observer: bind, one action, unbind, repeat the action, rebind, one action. Record deltas rather than totals alone.

fields.label: One-file diff summary
fields.help: State the one edited path and the protected-file check result. A normal runtime error is not evidence of correct edit scope.

fields.label: Actual result and comparison
fields.help: Compare the result with the prior prediction. For an approved browser alternative include AUTHORISATION: teacher, date, scope and reference.

fields.label: Browser evidence state for P02
fields.help: OBSERVED requires actual browser work; MODEL_OR_INJECTED alone is not browser evidence.

fields.label: Limit or unresolved defect
fields.help: State a demonstrated defect, an untested property or the next minimum check. This is not a claim of production readiness.

sections.title: Closure and declaration
sections.intro: Preserve prediction, actual observation, evidence origin and limitation. Write PENDING explicitly where applicable to a draft.

fields.label: State at the minute-60 stop and final update
fields.help: At minute 60 state the implementation status and outstanding browser, Gemini and P02 work. Add a dated final update without erasing the stop state.

fields.label: Specific learning reflection
fields.help: Explain one mechanism using your evidence, not a general confidence statement.

fields.label: Remaining uncertainty
fields.help: State the next smallest check that could change your conclusion.

fields.label: Evidence identifiers and origins
fields.help: List concise evidence IDs and origins. Screenshots supplement commands/actions; no full source archive is submitted.

fields.label: Truthful individual-work declaration
fields.help: I declare that the work and observations are my own, imported evidence has been reviewed and synthetic/pending material is labelled honestly. This does not certify correctness.
